scripts.update-dependencies: PREFIX="decaf-ts"; npm ls | grep "$PREFIX" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | sed 's/@.*//' | xargs -I package npm update @"$PREFIX"/package
scripts.set-git-auth: git config url."https://api:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/" && git config url."https://ssh:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "ssh://git@github.com/" && git config url."https://git:$(cat .token)@github.com/".insteadOf "git@github.com:"
scripts.reset: rm -rf * && git checkout . && git pull && npm run do-install
scripts.build: decaf build --dev && sed -i -e '1i#!/usr/bin/env node\' lib/cjs/bin/weaver-images.cjs && chmod +x lib/cjs/bin/weaver-images.cjs
scripts.build:prod: decaf build --prod && sed -i -e '1i#!/usr/bin/env node\' lib/cjs/bin/weaver-images.cjs && chmod +x lib/cjs/bin/weaver-images.cjs
scripts.prepare-release: npm run lint-fix && npm run build:prod && npm run coverage && npm run docs
scripts.drawings: for FILE in workdocs/drawings/*.drawio; do echo "converting $FILE to image..." && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data rlespinasse/drawio-export --format png $FILE; done && cp -rf workdocs/drawings/export/* workdocs/resources/
scripts.uml: cd workdocs/uml && for FILE in ./*.puml; do docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work miy4/plantuml -DPLANTUML_LIMIT_SIZE=8192 -tpng $FILE; done && cd ../.. && cp -fr workdocs/uml/*.png workdocs/resources/
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build-base && npm run docker:build-couchdb && npm run docker:build-builder && npm run docker:build-weaver
scripts.docker:build-builder: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:builder-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:builder-2.5.12-latest --target=builder -f ./Dockerfile-fabric .
scripts.docker:build-base: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:base-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:base-2.5.12-latest -f ./Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:build-weaver: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=TOKEN,src=$PWD/.npmtoken -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:weaver-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:weaver-2.5.12-latest -f ./Dockerfile-fabric .
scripts.docker:publish: npm run docker:publish-base && docker:publish-couchdb && docker:publish-builder && npm run docker:publish-weaver
scripts.docker:publish-couchdb: docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:couchdb-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:couchdb-latest
scripts.docker:publish-builder: docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:builder-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:builder-2.5.12-latest
scripts.docker:publish-weaver: docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:weaver-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:weaver-2.5.12-latest
scripts.docker:publish-base: docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:base-2.5.12-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/fabric-weaver:base-2.5.12-latest
